fullContentHtml:
CIPET Admit Card 2025 - Complete Details

Short Information : Central Institute of Petrochemicals Engineering & Technology (CIPET) has released the admit card for the Diploma / Post Diploma & PG Diploma Courses Admission 2025 for which the online application process has started from 07 February 2025. Any candidate who is interested to fill this form, they should check eligibility, age limit & must read the Full Notification Before applying for the CIPET Admit Card 2025. Those Candidates Are Interested in the following recruitment can apply online from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 07 February 2025
  • Last Date : 29 May 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 29 May 2025
  • Exam Date : 08 June 2025
  • Admit Card Available : 04 June 2025

Application Fee

  • General, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 100/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.

CIPET Admit Card 2025 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

The last date to apply is 29 May 2025.

The official website is: https://www.cipet.gov.in/

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
